words.translation: The pleasant, earthy smell after rain falls on dry soil
words.sentence1: The sudden downpour released a wave of petrichor that filled the afternoon air. (The sudden downpour released a wave of petrichor that filled the afternoon air.)
words.sentence2: I always step outside after a storm just to breathe in the petrichor. (I always step outside after a storm just to breathe in the petrichor.)

words.translation: The time spent lingering around the table after a meal
words.sentence1: Nuestra sobremesa duró dos horas entre café y risas. (Our lingering conversation after the meal lasted two hours amid coffee and laughter.)
words.sentence2: La sobremesa es mi parte favorita de las reuniones familiares. (The post-meal conversation is my favorite part of family gatherings.)

words.translation: Short-lived or lasting for a very short time
words.sentence1: La beauté de ce coucher de soleil était purement éphémère. (The beauty of this sunset was purely ephemeral.)
words.sentence2: Nous avons partagé un moment éphémère mais inoubliable sur le quai. (We shared a fleeting but unforgettable moment on the dock.)

words.translation: An ache for distant places; longing for travel
words.sentence1: Jedes Mal, wenn ich Flugzeuge sehe, packt mich das Fernweh. (Every time I see airplanes, I am seized by wanderlust.)
words.sentence2: Das Fernweh trieb ihn dazu, seinen Job zu kündigen und die Welt zu bereisen. (The longing for distant places drove him to quit his job and travel the world.)

words.translation: Sunlight filtering through the leaves of trees
words.sentence1: 木漏れ日の中で読書をするのが最高に気持ちいい。 (Reading a book amidst sunlight filtering through trees feels wonderful.)
words.sentence2: 森の中の木漏れ日が、まるで魔法のような空間を作っていた。 (The sunlight filtering through the trees in the forest created a magical space.)

words.translation: To rest in the shade during the hottest hours of the day
words.sentence1: Mi piace meriggiare sotto il grande ulivo in giardino. (I like to rest in the shade under the large olive tree in the garden.)
words.sentence2: Il caldo era così intenso che l'unica scelta era meriggiare. (The heat was so intense that the only choice was to rest in the shade.)

words.translation: Years; the passage of time; time as a flowing experience
words.sentence1: 岁月静好，现世安稳。 (May the years be peaceful, and may life be secure.)
words.sentence2: 他在岁月的沉淀中变得越来越从容。 (He became more composed through the passage of time.)

words.translation: A deep, lingering longing or yearning for someone or something
words.sentence1: 그리움은 계절처럼 돌고 돌아 다시 찾아온다. (Longing returns again and again like the seasons.)
words.sentence2: 오랜 친구를 향한 그리움이 사무친다. (The yearning for an old friend is deeply felt.)

words.sentence1: ក្តីស្រលាញ់របស់ម្តាយគឺជាក្តីស្រលាញ់ដ៏អមតៈ។ (A mother's love is an eternal love.)
words.sentence2: សិល្បៈខ្មែរមានភាពអមតៈតាមរយៈប្រាសាទបុរាណ។ (Khmer art is immortal through ancient temples.)

words.translation: The vast expanse of the heavens or sky
words.sentence1: Die sterre skyn helder in die uitgestrekte hemelruim. (The stars shine brightly in the vast expanse of the heavens.)
words.sentence2: Hy het na die hemelruim gestaar en gewonder oor die heelal. (He stared at the expanse of the sky and wondered about the universe.)
